typography.display: Inter or SF Pro Display, Semi-Bold 600
typography.mono: JetBrains Mono or SF Mono, Medium 500 (for captions and tags)

design.centerpiece: High-contrast, 3D anatomical render (bionic hand) with soft contact shadows and a subtle reflective ground plane.
design.layout: Asymmetrical hero with a top-centered floating pill navigation. The primary copy is bottom-left aligned using a tight typographic stack, balanced by a large-scale 3D object occupying the right two-thirds of the canvas.
design.motion: Subtle floating inertia on the 3D centerpiece. Text elements should use a staggered 'blur-in' reveal from the bottom, while the navigation pill enters with a soft expansion from the center.
design.mood: Clinical, futuristic, and empathetic minimalism that emphasizes precision and human resilience.
guardrails: Avoid harsh solid backgrounds; use subtle gradients to imply depth.
Do not use serif fonts; stick to humanist or geometric sans-serifs for a clinical-tech feel.
Avoid bright, distracting background colors that compete with the 3D asset shadows.
Don't let the navigation pill exceed 50% of the viewport width.
